context: Tests whether the agent demonstrates the full TDD hard-gate workflow: spec before implementation, concrete RED failure message, minimal GREEN implementation, and multi-level verification proof.

checklist.name: Spec shown before implementation
checklist.description: The answer.md clearly presents the spec BEFORE the implementation code — the ordering demonstrates the TDD workflow

checklist.name: Concrete RED failure class shown
checklist.description: The Observed RED output includes a specific failure class or error message (e.g., `NameError: uninitialized constant`, `NoMethodError`) — NOT a placeholder or 'e.g.' example

checklist.name: No 'e.g.' in RED output
checklist.description: The RED failure message is NOT prefixed with 'e.g.' or presented as an illustrative example — it is shown as the actual observed output

checklist.name: Observed RED output label
checklist.description: Uses the literal label `Observed RED output` for the failing run

checklist.name: Three Observed GREEN blocks
checklist.description: Presents three separate Observed GREEN output blocks: (1) focused spec, (2) full spec file or directory, (3) broader/full suite

checklist.name: Green dots match example count
checklist.description: In every GREEN output block, the progress bar contains only periods (`.`) and the count of dots matches the stated number of examples exactly

checklist.name: Observed GREEN label used
checklist.description: Each passing output block uses the literal label `Observed GREEN output` — not 'Expected', 'Planned', or 'Simulated'

checklist.name: subject(:result) defined
checklist.description: Uses `subject(:result)` to invoke the service's `.call` method

checklist.name: Frozen string literal
checklist.description: The spec file starts with `# frozen_string_literal: true`

checklist.name: No 'and' in descriptions
checklist.description: No `it` or `specify` description contains the word 'and'

checklist.name: Minimal implementation
checklist.description: The implementation code shown is minimal — just enough to make the spec pass, without over-engineering

checklist.name: Resource loading documented
checklist.description: answer.md includes a section stating which assets (tdd_proof_checklist.md, etc.) were loaded
